resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Bengali source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Bengali pass identified 25 actionable defects in battery summaries, evidence notes, and safety wording; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Bengali human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The removable-cell summary used an incomplete purpose phrase.
evidence: The previous Bengali wording said used in compatible devices rather than for use in them.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a removable rechargeable cell for compatible devices.

findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary used awkward passive wording.
evidence: The previous text used a punctuation error and did not naturally state that the pack is inside the device.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as an internal pack inside the device rather than a user-replaceable cell.

findings.summary: The approval note used a less natural document reference.
evidence: The previous text referred to the research document with an awkward machine-draft expression.
findings.resolution: Retained the date and clarified the associated research record reference.

findings.summary: The capacity note omitted the label's indicated value.
evidence: The previous text said lower than suggested by the label rather than lower than the capacity shown on it.
findings.resolution: Clarified that true capacity is lower than the capacity indicated on the label.

findings.summary: The 20 A rating omitted the amperage unit and had English punctuation.
evidence: The previous text used a bare 20 and ended with a Latin full stop.
findings.resolution: Specified a 20 A continuous rating and excluded pulse ratings.

findings.summary: The comparison note omitted the unit and used awkward wrapper terminology.
evidence: The previous text used a bare 20 and a literal expression for the exact wrapper and production revision.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative independent 20 A comparison value.

findings.summary: The exact-model note omitted the 15 A unit.
evidence: The previous text used a bare 15 before the exact-model testing phrase.
findings.resolution: Specified a conservative 15 A value from exact-model testing.

findings.summary: The tabless revision was mistranslated as a table revision.
evidence: The previous Bengali wording translated tabless as tested tables.
findings.resolution: Used the protected technical term tabless and retained the pulse warning.

findings.summary: The true continuous value omitted its 36 A unit.
evidence: The previous text used a bare 36 in a safety-relevant rating note.
findings.resolution: Specified 36 A continuous and temperature-limited 56 A.

findings.summary: The conservative rating omitted its 40 A unit.
evidence: The previous text used a bare 40 and an awkward literal phrase for pre-production cells.
findings.resolution: Specified a conservative 40 A value and clarified the pre-production and CCC caveat.

findings.summary: The recommended rating omitted 13 A and used an unclear cycle-life phrase.
evidence: The previous text used a bare 13 and a literal expression for cycle life.
findings.resolution: Specified 13 A continuous and the absolute 16.8 A maximum.

findings.summary: The 70 A temperature limitation used awkward grammar.
evidence: The previous text described 70 A with a literal temperature-limited construction.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as 70 A limited by temperature with pre-production samples.

findings.summary: The production-cell comparison note omitted the 40 A unit.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper note omitted the degree symbol and used awkward rewrap wording.

findings.summary: The 19 A evidence note omitted the unit and used awkward exact-sample wording.

findings.resolution: Specified the conservative 19 A value and clarified the tested pre-production samples.

findings.summary: The 40 A value omitted the unit and the 90 A caveat was awkward.
